$comment: Personalization on top of AllQuestions/all-questions-definition.json. Edit this file, then run the regenerate test in AllQuestionsPersonalizedTests to rewrite all-questions-personalized-definition.json, all-questions-personalized-variable-presets.json and the expected files. variablePresets declares the audience variables the way Hub passes the Audience Properties to Survey Creator, in the shape the Audience variables read returns: definition has one question per variable, typed by its Property's data type, and presets holds placeholder Test participants. Load all-questions-personalized-variable-presets.json as the designer's variablePresets. Every {variable} the bindings and addElements read must be declared there, and no question or calculated value may share a variable's name; AllQuestionsPersonalizedTests checks both. bindings set or replace properties of an existing question, found by name anywhere in the survey; addElements are appended to the first page.

addElements.name: city
addElements.title: Confirm the city you live in

addElements.name: lastVisit
addElements.title: When did you last visit us?
